integrity: Exact formulas and an analytic proof are supplied. Numerical checks are reproducibility aids rather than proof of an infinite statement. The constants were not independently certified.
limitations: The proof compares only two central hyperplane normals, is local in exponent around the established threshold and asymptotic in dimension. It gives neither a global optimizer for p below the threshold nor a finite-dimension statement for all n. Historical priority is provisional, and the original Oleszkiewicz chapter was not exhaustively inspected.
title: A sharp finite-size critical layer for diagonal sections of \(\ell_p\)-balls
